featureFlags.runtimeEvaluation: deterministic tenant, actor, region, environment, internal, and percentage evaluation
featureFlags.rollback: disable flag or set percentage to 0 without redeploying

blueGreen.rollback: switch traffic to previous color and preserve replay/queue cursor state

shadowTraffic.strategy: silent production traffic mirroring without side effects
shadowTraffic.sideEffectPolicy: shadow events, queues, provider calls, and writes must be tagged and non-mutating

sandboxProviders.stripe: test mode only outside production execute mode
sandboxProviders.razorpay: test mode only outside production execute mode
sandboxProviders.paypal: sandbox only outside production execute mode
sandboxProviders.email: mailpit locally, isolated sender domains remotely
sandboxProviders.queues: elasticmq locally, isolated Cloudflare queue namespaces remotely
sandboxProviders.guardrail: provider side effects are forbidden unless environment is production and certification mode is execute
